entries.zh: 奉承讨好，以礼物奉赠巴结；亦含敬献诚意、献纳财物之义
entries.en: to flatter and curry favor with gifts; to present offerings respectfully
entries.notes: 西语侧 fratar biens 拼写异常（疑为 tributar/frutar bienes 之讹），汉侧奉誠疑即「奉承」，均依赖推断

entries.zh: 款（欵）：诚恳；款待；款项、条目〔其余三栏皆空，义项无从定夺〕
entries.en: sincere; to entertain (guests); funds, item — only the Chinese column survives, sense undetermined
entries.notes: L/M/R 三栏皆空，仅存汉字一栏（欵为款之异体），语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 供养赡给；以佳肴美馔款待
entries.en: to provide for and sustain; to entertain with good food

entries.zh: 安顿（安顿客人，安置妥帖使其安歇舒适）
entries.en: to settle a guest comfortably; to lodge and put at ease

entries.zh: 款待（殷勤款待宾客）
entries.en: to entertain and regale a guest hospitably

entries.zh: 极有世事（极通人情礼数，待客馈赠殷勤周到）
entries.en: very observant of social courtesies; much given to gift-giving and hospitality to guests
entries.notes: 西语词头截断于 munchas 需推断补全；「世事」取闽南语「人情礼数」义

entries.zh: 娇惯、溺养成习（例指以乳哺与礼物娇惯孩童）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to pamper and spoil by habitual indulgence (as a child doted on with milk and gifts); [source lacunose, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: L 栏含 [残]，H 乘慣 与西语侧仅能部分互证

entries.zh: 洒水浇湿、滴水（浇水喷洒使湿；字头疑为「滴」，或作「湿」）
entries.en: to sprinkle or drip water on; to wet — character uncertain between 滴 (to drip) and 濕 (wet)
entries.notes: 汉字带 [疑]（濕/滴），依西语词头 regar/rocíar 取浇水喷洒义

entries.zh: 泼（泼水、倾泼液体）
entries.en: to splash; to dash water

entries.zh: 洒（洒水、喷洒）
entries.en: to sprinkle (water)

entries.zh: 喷洒、喷溅（「濆」，水喷涌浇洒）；字形或作「燌」（焚，焚烧）
entries.en: to spurt and spray water (濆); alternative character 燌/焚 'to burn'
entries.notes: 汉字带 [疑]（燌/濆），依西语词头 regar 取喷洒义

entries.zh: 泼水（浇水、泼洒）
entries.en: to splash or pour water

entries.zh: 讨价还价、争价（依西语词头 regatear）；汉字与音写互不印证，释义存疑
entries.en: to haggle over price (per Spanish lemma regatear); the Chinese form and Hokkien transcription do not corroborate — sense undetermined
entries.notes: H 疑吥/吓与音写 chien 互不印证，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 沸（沸腾）；西语词头作「低贱的小贩」（regatón vil），两不相合，释义存疑
entries.en: boiling (per Chinese 沸); the Spanish lemma instead reads 'mean huckster (regatón vil)' — columns do not corroborate, sense undetermined
entries.notes: L regatón vil 与 H 沸语义不合，无法互证

entries.zh: 贩（贩卖零星杂货；小贩做小买卖）
entries.en: to peddle; a huckster/peddler of small wares

entries.zh: 贩鲜人（贩卖鲜鱼鲜货之人；鱼贩）
entries.en: vendor of fresh fish or produce; fishmonger
entries.notes: M 栏尾残片 bu[残]cado（当为 pescado 残迹）；主体贩鮮人与西语互证清晰，因含 [残] 依纪律降为低置信

entries.zh: 老人（耆老、长老；以「长老」对应西语市政议员 regidores）
entries.en: elders, old men — the Chinese gloss renders Spanish regidores (town councilmen) as respected elders

entries.zh: 邑（城镇、市邑；对应西语市镇/市政会 regimiento，兼指军团）
entries.en: town, municipality (Chinese 邑); Spanish regimiento — town council in colonial usage, also a military regiment

entries.zh: 关（道路关隘、关卡，盘查登记行人货物之处）
entries.en: pass, checkpoint on the roads (Chinese 關); inspection and registry barrier

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [source lacunose, gloss withheld — only a truncated Spanish lemma survives]
entries.notes: 仅 L 栏残句 Region nt del ayuo（疑 ayuntamiento 残文），余三栏皆空
